title: Example inline deployment CLI
source_brief: Illustrative brief: a non-fullscreen CLI asks for a TTY confirmation, deploys to staging, writes status or error output into scrollback, and returns a meaningful process exit code.
assumptions: Illustrative command only; no real deployment is performed.
TTY-only confirmation (no stdin pipe input in this sample).
A declined prompt exits with code 130 to demonstrate a nonzero cancel path.
